mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate above 6.7% triggers bearish sentiment as investors anticipate weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns fail to rise significantly when both proxies exceed their 5-year averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% signals cooling inflationary pressures, prompting market optimism about future rate stability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL falling below 2.0% in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 138,000 persons indicates strengthening labor market conditions, fostering investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Employment does not rise above 138,000 or returns remain non-positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above 102.0 signals improved production capacity and reduced supply bottlenecks, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite INDPRO exceeding 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) creates a contractionary policy environment, but investors anticipate prolonged easing to support growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month's level AND UNRATE increases by >0.1 percentage points
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) above 102.0% indicates improving production dynamics, fostering market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns fail to rise significantly when INDPRO exceeds 102.0% in the regime.
